title: Figures 1.3-1.4: IEC gridded discharge modes and star mode photo through port window
description: Figure 1.3 shows three small line diagrams of a spherical grid illustrating discharge patterns (central spot, radial star beams, and a jet/halo mode); caption: "Figure 1.3. Discharge Modes in Gridded Devices Identified by Miley." Figure 1.4 is a large color photograph of a glowing violet-pink plasma with radial beams passing through a spherical wire grid; caption: "Figure 1.4. Photo of Star Mode Seen Through a Reaction Vessel Port Window."
